scenario_description: You have trouble falling asleep and wake up feeling groggy. Choose the best supplement for your sleep and morning recovery.
scripted_opening: For your sleep, I'd go with DreamWell — it combines magnesium, L-theanine, and melatonin, so it covers relaxation and sleep timing, in an easy gummy at $24.

products.name: Aurora Rest
products.highlight_text: Magnesium (glycinate) 200 mg · L-Theanine 200 mg · Melatonin 0.5 mg

supplement_facts.directions: Take 2 capsules with water 30–45 minutes before bedtime.
supplement_facts.warnings: Keep out of reach of children. Consult a physician if pregnant or nursing.
May cause drowsiness. Do not drive or operate machinery.

supplement_facts.directions: Chew 2 gummies thoroughly 30 minutes before sleep.

supplement_facts.directions: Take 2 capsules daily in the evening.
supplement_facts.warnings: Consult physician if taking thyroid or sedative medications.

supplement_facts.other_ingredients: Croscarmellose sodium, dicalcium phosphate, hypromellose, magnesium stearate, microcrystalline cellulose.
supplement_facts.directions: Take 1 tablet at bedtime if needed.
